{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jawa Council''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] government that oversaw the restoration of the [[Mos Ila Spaceport]]; however, the [[Exchange]] took over [[Mos Ila]] and drove the Jawas out of the [[City/Legends|city]]. Mos Ila was subsequently taken from the Exchange by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
